reasoning_sections.heading: Designing a signature layout
reasoning_sections.content: I'm thinking about placing the signature at the bottom, maybe on a dark foreground band to ensure it's easily visible. The name should be sized at 24 px, and the focus will be on the model name without a title. I need to ensure the text is readable against the background. I'll sketch the landscape including a house and tree positioning, while making sure the signature isn't hidden behind any elements like the lake. Keeping it simple is key!
